lines.t: ‎Come walk with Me in the garden once more
‎I have poured out My love, rivers overflowing for you
‎No more hiding, no more chains, beloved one
‎I delivered Myself up, just to draw you near
‎**[Pre-Chorus]**
‎Beloved, you have sought Me, in this you have done well
‎Yet the fullness of My love you have yet to understand
‎Only tasted... come, take your fill
‎If it's My love that you seek, then come to Me now
‎No more time to tarry, open your heart, let Me in
‎Come to Me, come to Me, come to Me, beloved
‎Di da di da di, come to Me, come to Me
‎If it's My love that you want, then turn to Me fully
‎I am waiting, I am calling, My arms open wide
‎Come to Me, come to Me, come to Me, beloved
‎Di da di da di, come to Me... Says The Lord
‎I have drawn near to open the eyes of all who desire
‎To look upon My face, partake of My glory
‎Beloved, listen and hear the love of your Father
‎A flood of joy flowing, never fading, never slumbering
‎**[Pre-Chorus]**
‎I am The Fulfillment of All Things
‎In My arms heaven and earth pass away
‎Only perfect fulfillment remains
‎You and I united, love’s completion
‎**[Chorus]**
‎(Spoken/Emphasized)
‎If it's My love that you seek, then come to Me now
‎No more time to tarry, open your heart, let Me in
‎Come to Me, come to Me, come to Me, beloved
‎Di da di da di, come to Me, come to Me
‎If it's My love that you want, then turn to Me fully
‎I am waiting, I am calling, My arms open wide
‎Come to Me, come to Me, come to Me, beloved
‎Di da di da di, come to Me... Says The Lord
‎**[Bridge]**
‎At what moment did I turn back, when I poured out My love?
‎A testament of My love and sacrifice
‎The announcement of My coming, come to Me in season
‎Beloved, those with Me have never departed
‎I knew you and loved you, even upon the cross
‎**[Final Chorus (build with layers)]**
‎If it's My love that you seek, then come to Me now
‎No more time to tarry... come, beloved, come
‎Come to Me, come to Me, come to Me
‎Di da di da di, come to Me forever
‎If it's My love that you want, accept it today
‎My joy, My glory, My arms forever
‎Come to Me... Says The Lord
